title: AI-Powered Smart Survey & Polling Platform
description: Developed a multilingual and multimodal survey platform for creating, distributing, collecting, and analyzing survey responses. The platform combines React, FastAPI, and Spring Boot services with AI-powered semantic analysis, translation, voice interaction, and SMS/WhatsApp survey distribution.
problemSolved: Traditional survey platforms often require separate systems for survey creation, distribution, multilingual interaction, and response analysis. This project provides a unified platform with AI-assisted analysis and multimodal citizen interaction.
challenges: Integrating multiple services built with different technologies while maintaining reliable communication between the React frontend, FastAPI AI engine, and Spring Boot communication service. Another challenge was integrating AI-based semantic processing, multilingual translation, voice functionality, and communication APIs into a single survey workflow.
lessonsLearned: Gained practical experience in microservice-based application development, REST API integration, AI/RAG workflows using embeddings, multilingual processing, Spring Boot services, FastAPI, and third-party API integration.

title: Battery Vehicle Booking System
description: Developed a role-based battery vehicle booking system that manages vehicle requests, approvals, dispatch, and completion workflows for students, administrators, and watchmen. The backend was migrated from Node.js/MongoDB to Java Spring Boot with JPA/Hibernate and a MySQL-compatible TiDB Cloud database.
problemSolved: Managing battery vehicle requests manually can lead to scheduling conflicts, unclear approval workflows, and poor visibility into booking status. The system centralizes booking, approval, and vehicle operation workflows for students, administrators, and watchmen.
challenges: Migrating the backend from a document-oriented MongoDB data model to a relational database while preserving existing API contracts and business logic. Another challenge was restructuring the Node.js backend into a layered Spring Boot architecture using controllers, services, repositories, entities, and DTOs.
lessonsLearned: Gained practical experience in Java Spring Boot backend development, REST API design, JPA/Hibernate, relational database modeling, JWT authentication, role-based authorization, and migrating an existing Node.js/MongoDB application to a Java-based relational architecture.

title: Multi-Cloud Monitoring & Cost Optimization Platform
description: Developed a multi-cloud monitoring platform using React and FastAPI to monitor AWS and Azure resources, analyze cloud usage and costs, detect anomalies using machine learning, generate optimization recommendations, and perform resilience testing.
problemSolved: Managing cloud infrastructure across multiple providers makes resource monitoring, cost analysis, anomaly detection, and optimization difficult. The platform provides a unified interface for monitoring AWS and Azure resources and analyzing their usage and costs.
challenges: Integrating different cloud provider APIs with different resource structures and billing models into a unified monitoring platform. Another challenge was processing cloud usage data for anomaly detection, cost prediction, and optimization analysis.
lessonsLearned: Gained practical experience working with AWS and Azure APIs, cloud monitoring and billing services, FastAPI-based backend development, machine learning for anomaly detection, data processing, visualization, and cloud resilience testing.

title: E-Tutor Online Tutoring Platform
description: Developing an online tutoring platform designed to connect students and tutors through course discovery, tutor management, session scheduling, learning interactions, and online payments.
problemSolved: Students and tutors need a centralized platform to manage tutoring activities, courses, sessions, authentication, and payments. The platform provides a unified full-stack solution for managing these interactions.
challenges: Designing a full-stack architecture with separate React frontend and Node.js/Express backend layers while integrating authentication, database operations, tutoring workflows, and third-party payment services.
lessonsLearned: Gained practical experience in full-stack application development, React frontend development, Express REST API development, authentication, database integration, and third-party payment API integration.

title: AI-Driven Learning Path Optimizer
description: Developed an AI-powered learning platform that generates personalized, bootcamp-style learning roadmaps based on a user's career goals, existing skills, and available study time.
problemSolved: Students and developers often struggle to determine what skills to learn and in what order due to the large amount of available learning content. The platform generates structured and personalized learning paths based on career goals, existing skills, and available study time.
challenges: Designing a system that can transform a user's career goals, existing skills, and available study time into a structured learning roadmap. Another challenge was integrating AI-generated content into the application while maintaining secure authentication and multi-device session management.
lessonsLearned: Gained practical experience in full-stack development, AI API integration, personalized recommendation workflows, JWT and refresh-token authentication, HTTP-only cookies, session management, and building structured learning experiences with generative AI.
